description: P11-2 StoryNPCs compatibility map. Expands over target-surface-manifest.json: every inventory row resolves to exactly one terminal mapping state through surface_defaults or a row_override. Terminal states: INVENTORY_ONLY (non-behavioral static inventory), MAPPED_STORYNPCS_OBSERVED (StoryNPCs implementation + JVM evidence exists), INTENTIONAL_DEVIATION (documented redesign with rationale), UNVERIFIED_STORYNPCS (implementation gap — evidence required), UNKNOWN (unclassified — evidence required). No state claims target-runtime parity: every non-inventory row also records parity_state UNVERIFIED_TARGET_RUNTIME because target probes are unavailable.

target_classes.note: Static class inventory; behavioral coverage flows through the fixture-referenced surfaces.

assets.storynpcs_ref: P3-1/P8-3: namespaced asset references validated by DisplayProjection + creator schemas
assets.note: StoryNPCs-side schema coverage; asset byte equivalence unverified.

data.storynpcs_ref: P2-1: versioned YAML families with envelope + migration boundary

gui.note: 149 target GUI classes consolidated into typed hub panels; screen-level equivalence unverified.

packets.storynpcs_ref: P1-3: versioned bounded protocol with session binding
packets.note: Undocumented target packet formats intentionally not preserved (P1-3 non-goal).

commands.storynpcs_ref: P9-3: /storynpcs typed command tree + suggestion engine
commands.note: 70 target leaves mapped semantically onto the namespaced typed tree; literal /noppes grammar not preserved.

events.storynpcs_ref: P9-1: typed api.event surface + canonical mutation events
events.note: Semantic coverage observed in tests; one-to-one class equivalence unverified.

roles.storynpcs_ref: P6-2/P7-1/P7-2: trader, banker, postman, healer, bard + follower/companion roles

jobs.storynpcs_ref: P6-4: JobType/JobConfig/JobInstance — all eleven target jobs

companion_jobs.storynpcs_ref: P6-5: CompanionProfile + job assignment + wage ledger

persistence_stores.storynpcs_ref: P2-2: PersistenceStoreMap maps all 18 target store categories

operation_matrix.storynpcs_ref: P1-1..P1-4: 15 operation families typed through StoryNpcsApplicationService

deviations.rationale: The target's 149 GUI classes encode legacy per-screen widgets; StoryNPCs delivers the same authoring surface through one server-authoritative hub with typed panels, search/pagination, undo/redo, and revisioned saves.
deviations.migration_impact: Creator workflows use the hub panels instead of one window per feature; documented in docs/creator/QUICKSTART.md.

deviations.rationale: Target packet formats are undocumented internals; P1-3 replaces them with versioned, size-bounded, session-bound, replay-safe payloads.
deviations.migration_impact: Third-party integrations must use the public API (P9-1), not wire-level compatibility.

deviations.rationale: The /noppes grammar predates Brigadier conventions; /storynpcs uses typed literals, namespaced IDs, and deterministic suggestions — see P9-PROGRESS.md for the leaf mapping.
deviations.migration_impact: Command scripts written for /noppes require translation; every leaf maps to a /storynpcs equivalent or an explicit gap in the parity register.

deviations.rationale: Target dialogues are fixed option arrays; StoryNPCs uses directed graphs (nodes + typed edges) enabling branching, loops, and conditions.
deviations.migration_impact: Legacy option-array content imports into graph nodes; cycles are legal and diagnosed as warnings.

deviations.rationale: Arbitrary script source on definitions is rejected; the P9-2 host exposes nine typed hooks under instruction/memory/depth/operation budgets.
deviations.migration_impact: CustomNPCs .js scripts are UNSUPPORTED at import (reported, never silently dropped); behavior must be re-authored as typed hook bindings.
